origin: Independently reasoned literal outcome vectors, adapted from reviewed technical closures into distinct authored assignments; not recorded evaluator outputs. Native and runtime acceptance remain pending.

lessons.reason: A passive port can answer but does not start this modeled LACP agreement. Each p1/p2 cable needs an active end; Active/Passive and Active/Active both work. Only compatible ports participate. VLAN admission is checked separately. Matching group names alone do not prove that a bundle formed.

A member must match its own local group template. A correct remote port cannot fix a local profile mismatch. A participating bundle can still exclude a required VLAN. Keep each local template and its member profiles consistent, and allow both required VLANs at both ends. Additional allowed VLANs from the supplied database are a valid alternative.

Three participating pairs leave two when one fails; four is also valid. Each supplied cable-loss state is evaluated independently of current service. Clearing previous proves a completed migration. Preserving operations prevents fixing the target by damaging a neighboring service.
